title: Unauthenticated debug endpoint exposes configuration
description: Confirmed via authorized dynamic request against staging that /internal/debug/config returns configuration without authentication.

reproduction_steps: Confirm written authorization for staging payments-api assessment.
Send GET https://payments.staging.example.internal/internal/debug/config with no Authorization header.
Observe HTTP 200 with configuration JSON including non-public keys.
evidence.observed_behavior: HTTP 200 with configuration payload and no auth challenge.
evidence.expected_behavior: HTTP 401/403 or route disabled outside local development.
